faq.h2: Sensible answers, none of the legalese.

items.q: How does the 3-month free trial work?
items.a: Start by messaging our Telegram bot — no card, no email needed. Send /start and your account is active immediately. Finish linking a web account anytime to unlock the full dashboard. Every feature is unlocked for 90 days. When the trial ends, choose monthly, 6-month, or annual to keep going, or export your data and walk away.

items.q: Can I use it without creating a web account?
items.a: Yes — the Telegram bot works entirely on its own throughout your trial and subscription. Log expenses, query summaries, set budgets, and schedule daily digests without ever visiting the website. The web dashboard is optional and adds charts, heatmaps, and AI summaries on top.

items.q: What happens after my 3-month free trial?
items.a: You'll be charged on the cycle you picked at signup — Monthly, 6 months, or Annual. We send Telegram and email reminders 15 days before. If you don't add a card, your account switches to read-only mode. Nothing is ever deleted.

items.q: How does the Telegram bot know what I mean?
items.a: The bot uses an AI model to parse free-text messages. It extracts the amount, currency, category, merchant, and date — including relative dates like "yesterday" or "last Friday". For large amounts (≥50,000 BDT) it always asks for confirmation before logging.

items.q: Why does web signup go through Telegram?
items.a: Telegram acts as your identity anchor. The bot gives you a 6-digit one-time code that you paste on the web signup page — this links your bot conversations to your web account securely without passwords.

items.q: Is there an iOS or Android app?
items.a: ExpenseFlow is a Progressive Web App (PWA) — install it from Safari on iOS or Chrome on Android. It opens full-screen with its own icon, works offline, and auto-syncs when you reconnect.

You set a base currency for storage (e.g. BDT) and a separate display currency (e.g. USD). All transactions are stored in your base currency using live FX rates at the time of logging. You can change your display currency freely at any time — your stored data is never altered.

items.q: Can I switch billing cycles later?
items.a: Yes — switch monthly ↔ 6-month ↔ annual from your account settings at any time. The unused balance is prorated toward the new plan.

Three concrete things: (1) parsing your free-text messages into structured transactions, (2) writing your monthly spending summary in plain English, and (3) answering questions like "how much did I spend on food last week?" in the chat.

All data is transmitted over HTTPS. Your Telegram account is verified via a one-time code — we never see your Telegram credentials. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time, with a 15-day grace period.
Live FX rates for 120+ currencies. No bank sync is required — you log transactions directly via the bot or the web dashboard. CSV import is available for bulk historical data.
